Frontend smoke on mobile viewport (390x844): P0 regression on /all-courses renders (no red screen), Classes tab shows Pro Partner card, tapping opens /classes/pro-partner (screenshot confirms Pro Partner hero + TEFL Certified card + 'Find your Pro Partner' CTA). /vocab-hub shows testID vh-placement AND vh-leaderboard (both present in DOM). /leaderboard shows Global+Friends tab pills and correctly renders the 'No XP yet this week' empty state with 'Start learning' CTA (backend returned empty entries for global — expected). /saved-moments route resolves. One frontend finding: the [data-testid="lb-me-bar"] node was NOT found in the DOM on the empty-state leaderboard screen — spec says the my-rank footer bar should ALWAYS be visible, but it seems the conditional render only mounts it when the FlatList has data.

rca_of_issue: Bug — lb-me-bar hidden on empty state. RCA: /app/frontend/app/leaderboard.tsx line 228 uses `{board && (<View testID='lb-me-bar' ...`. This suggests the `board` state is set when entries exist but might be reset to null / not set when the empty-state branch is taken. Alternatively the JSX correctly gates on `board` but `board` may be null while empty state renders (empty state may derive from `!loading && !board` rather than `board.entries.length===0`). Repro: log in as fresh user with 0 weekly XP → visit /leaderboard → observe empty trophy screen with 'Start learning' CTA → note absence of the sticky footer row that should show '#— · me · 0 XP'. Mitigation: (a) ensure the empty-state branch requires `board !== null && board.entries.length === 0`, and (b) either drop the outer `{board && ...}` guard on the me-bar or fall back to a hard-coded '#— · <me> · 0 XP' row from the local user store when board is still loading.
